feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 22 May 2026 4:35am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 22 May 2026 at 4:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Generally dry, with some low cloud and mist patches developing in southern and central areas. Otherwise, many places will see bright or sunny spells. Some light rain may develop for a time later in the evening. Moderate to fresh south or southwest winds will ease later, with temperatures reaching around 17°C in the north.


##Outlook##

A largely fine and dry weekend, with decent spells of sunshine and temperatures in the high teens. However, mist may affect some coasts at times.
